hangzhou-22.bio: A low hill above West Lake's east shore with temples, the Chenghuang Pavilion tower and views over Hangzhou.
hangzhou-22.costPer: Chenghuang Pavilion only; the rest of the hill is free
hangzhou-22.ticket_note: no official site found; hill is run by the city, tower fee reported by news/Ctrip only
hangzhou-22.notes: Only the Chenghuang Pavilion is ticketed (30 CNY per a May 2026 news report seen via search); other areas free. Tower was closed for renovation in 2024-25: reopening unverified. Consider free/open if the hill itself is the spot.

anji-1.bio: Bamboo-covered hills at Tianhuangping near Anji, a film location for Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.
anji-1.ticket_note: no official site found; ticket office phone 0572-5210999 only
anji-1.notes: 58 CNY is from a 2022 travel post (original price), unverified; discounted 50 from ticket reseller. Film-location claim comes from the draft, not re-verified. Not the Yixing bamboo sea in Jiangsu.

dapan-mountain.bio: Forested peak and nature reserve in Pan'an, central Zhejiang, with hiking trails and herb-rich slopes.
dapan-mountain.ticket_note: no official site found; the reserve's own site link on Wikipedia is dead
dapan-mountain.notes: Peak is 1245 m in Dapanshan National Nature Reserve. Free entry comes from the draft only; no source found, so unverified. 'herb-rich slopes' is unverified: rewrite the bio if not confirmed. Do not use English Wikipedia title (none exists).

ningbo-6.bio: A restored 19th-century Fujianese merchants' guildhall and Mazu temple in Ningbo, now a maritime and folk-art museum.
ningbo-6.ticket_note: museum has no verified official site (old site only in an archived Wikipedia link)
ningbo-6.notes: 10 CNY adult from Chinese Wikipedia (ticket section, 2009 museum page archived); may have changed. Sources disagree on whether Monday is closed: no hours recorded.

shaoxing-3.bio: A garden of ponds, pavilions and a winding stream where Wang Xizhi wrote the Orchid Pavilion Preface in 353.
shaoxing-3.ticket_note: official site not found; only Ctrip/Qunar/resellers
shaoxing-3.notes: Price 70 (reseller 2025) vs 80 (Qunar review): conflicting, weak. Combined ticket with Shen Garden, East Lake, Yu Mausoleum from 145 CNY. No English Wikipedia article for the pavilion.

lulan-qingsha.bio: A 3.6 km curve of fine sand on Daishan Island's east coast, with a paid beach park and water sports.
lulan-qingsha.notes: 30 CNY from one Ctrip review; 3.6 km length from draft; 'water sports' from a 2026 news snippet about upgrades. All weak/unverified; scenic area was being upgraded in 2026.
